term: possibility of every finite prefix versus completed infinite task
resolution: The first existential capacity witness may depend on the chosen finite prefix (for every prefix there exists a world). The second fixes one world before quantifying over all prefixes (there exists a world for every prefix). Their inequivalence invalidates that bare quantifier shift but does not refute a supertask supported by a genuinely infinite-capacity world or other independent completion principle.
label: Possibility of every finite prefix versus completed infinite task
